body: Forward test of the management-tone-vs-delivery method (NOT a recommendation; not buy/sell). Probability 0.35 (naive base rate 0.60) that: Lupin Q3 FY27 company-reported EBITDA margin (ex-forex & other income) is ≥24.0%. Evidence: Q2 FY27 call (Nov-2026): Q2 EBITDA ex-forex/other income ₹1,957 cr, margin 25.1% vs 31.3% a year ago; FY27 margin guide 'around 24–25%' with CEO Vinita Gupta saying margins 'likely to moderate in the coming quarters' (US competition in key products, R&D ~8% of sales, input costs). Screener OPM path: Mar-26 33%, Jun-26 30%, Sep-26 26%. US revenue guide $1.1–1.2 bn. Reasoning: Management is telling us, unusually explicitly, that margins fall from 25.1%; a full-year 24–25% with H1 ~27–28% implies H2 nearer 21–23%. We weight management's downbeat tone over persistence. Resolution: YES if the EBITDA margin excluding forex and other income for Q3 FY27, as stated in Lupin's Q3 press release/call, is ≥24.0%. If not stated, compute (EBITDA − other income − forex gain) ÷ revenue from operations from the results. Source: Lupin Q3 FY27 results press release / earnings call transcript. Resolve by 2027-02-28; score with Brier vs base rate.
